status: Bounded design review; worth a native-DAG falsification screen, not an established novel method
conclusion: Per-expert heterogeneous parallelism and unequal sharding are direct prior art. The narrower untested question is whether static one-copy complete-row GU/Down integer profiles must be selected jointly under ordinary NAND page/wave/block geometry and the full-GU host barrier. A new screen can test this, but the default attribution is a careful existing-method port until it beats geometry-matched native controls and exposes a reproducible interaction missed by simpler choices.

primary_sources.name: HDA-MoE
primary_sources.read_scope: Paper II,IV,V-A/V-B and pinned placement code were read in the immediately preceding audit;see sources.json.
primary_sources.covers: Each expert has its own continuous allocation P_ic, allowing different EP/TP-like distributions under capacity and compute/communication objectives.
primary_sources.not_established: No inspected per-projection integer row profile variables or ordinary-NAND full-row job/address lowering. Its per-expert freedom already covers the broad heterogeneous-sharding premise;native GU/Down profile coupling remains a narrower question.

primary_sources.name: AnchorTP
primary_sources.read_scope: Read III-B,Algorithm1,III-C and implementation/limitations excerpts;not the full evaluation or code.
primary_sources.covers: Unequal floor/ceil shards permit arbitrary TP degrees;contiguous intervals and minimal-reload migration preserve GPU state.
primary_sources.not_established: Focus is elastic GPU recovery/reconfiguration,not route-aware static per-expert GU/Down profile selection. Does not supply NAND page costs or authorize free runtime NAND reshaping.

primary_sources.name: Tutel:Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts at Scale
primary_sources.read_scope: Read3.1 including switchable parameter slicing/group parameter r,3.2 overview and3.3 optimal-setup dictionary;did not run code.
primary_sources.covers: Adaptive EP/DP/MP and pipelining selection using one sharded parameter layout. Runtime degree selection and communication-aware strategy search are established.
primary_sources.not_established: The described r is a parallelism-group setting,not independently chosen integer GU/Down profiles for each expert. Its all-gather/collective mechanism cannot be assumed free on NAND.

primary_sources.name: MoEShard:Accelerating MoE Model Inference with Expert Sharding
primary_sources.read_scope: Read system assumptions,Algorithm1 and3.1-3.2;not all evaluation or implementation.
primary_sources.covers: One-copy shards of every expert across GPUs;paired first-layer output/second-layer input slices and partial-output aggregation.
primary_sources.not_established: Uses equal shards across all GPUs with divisibility simplified;not heterogeneous per-expert native NAND profiles. Its column partials are a different numeric contract.

old_mixed_profiles.scope: Original32train prompts x64steps;G4first3layers,G3/Qwen3first2;GU/down optimized separately using scalar phase cost. Width1..16,16cyclic offsets,floor/ceil complete rows plus wave templates;many fixed/mixed starts.
old_mixed_profiles.result: No mixed-profile survivor. G3/Qwen3 zero;G4 raw0.0020665% search difference remained all-g12,so attributable mixture benefit zero.
old_mixed_profiles.meaning: A strong prior negative screen,not a global impossibility proof or a full joint native-DAG actual-W8 study. Reuse its menu and starts rather than merely rerunning the phase scalar objective.

shared_frontier.scope: Deep sharedDown exact single-matrix work/depth/commands frontier,balanced active-count alternatives and equal96-wave reference;strong one-copy integer/MILP constructions and row-transfer refinements across26layers.
shared_frontier.limits: The saved oracle is a necessary chip-occupancy/critical-path study,not full global controller/channel native-DAG service. Input/output contract used useful-row terms in places,so re-lower through the current all-page-fringe engine.
shared_frontier.known_headroom: Under its then-fixed routed geometry,the unlimited pooling NAND mean bound leaves2.0923% versus fitted one-copy. This does not bound a new mixed-routed-profile family.
shared_frontier.reuse: Reuse legal frontier rows,not a new shared search or equal128-row/96-wave-only baseline. Retain89-wave balanced16/15active and88-wave deeper profiles. Keep shared profile pool/orientation identical for every routed family.

same_native_controls: Best uniform GU/Down profile PAIR from the exact same menu,selected jointly by the current full native DAG. Include all cyclic widths and independent simple balanced-wave controls;retain the actual frozen winners and v2 unrestricted paired-move control.

Phasewise mixed-profile fit using the old scalar objective,then lower/replay with the SAME native engine and actual W8 TRAIN routes. This isolates the contribution of joint causal cost rather than mixed widths alone.

HDA-style marginal-frequency profile/placement selection,rounded through the SAME legal whole-row menu and evaluated with the SAME native DAG. Label this a native adaptation,not unmodified HDA reproduction.

Joint mixed profile fit,warm-started from every retained uniform incumbent and with both phase-specific and coupled profile/mask moves. Give uniform controls matching native replay budget/multistarts;preserve the uniform incumbent so merely taking a different search path is not credited to mixtures.

Matched shared frontier and orientation pool,one-copy useful weights,exact per-chip pages/waves/commands and global allocated capacity. No free input retention or relaxed whole-GU barrier;all-page fringe,private/sharedDown input sizes and copies1/4 are identical.

Report actual nonuniform profile assignments and compare each winning mixed plan to a refit uniform plan with its most-used profiles. If every expert chooses one common family,attribute mixed benefit zero.

defensible_narrow_hypothesis.claim_to_test: The best static GU/Down profile pair for an expert depends on routed co-activation and shared-chip offsets through command ownership and full-GU readiness,not only on its marginal frequency or isolated expert latency. Integer wave depth can make uniform and per-phase scalar choices systematically wrong.
defensible_narrow_hypothesis.needed_evidence: Show specific native trace counterexamples where a selected mixed pair shortens the GU-to-Down critical path after all work/command/input/output costs,then repeat an attributable gain over same-native best-uniform/joint/free controls. Explain the mechanism rather than calling the menu search new.
defensible_narrow_hypothesis.not_novel_by_itself: Different widths per expert,unequal shards,hybrid parallelism,profile search,DP/annealing and full-DAG scheduling are not first claims.
defensible_narrow_hypothesis.dominance_warning: Do not prune distinct physical profiles solely by(total waves,max depth,jobcount). A scalar-dominated profile may have useful per-chip load shape or readiness interaction. Keep matched balanced controls as already learned in shared-frontier audit.

bounded_falsification: First screen a few extremal legal profiles(minimum work,minimum job depth,low commands) plus existing winners on the same actual-W8 TRAIN first3layers. Compare full native cost;do not acquire new heldout or infer models for this screen.

If a very optimistic route-adaptive profile/work-DAG relaxation already leaves less than the coordinating research screen threshold,archive this family. Otherwise a negative small local search is a finite-search negative result,not proof of no mixed optimum.
If gains disappear under best uniform joint selection,shared frontier matching,paired-move starts or equal search budget,record an existing-method port/control result and stop expansion.

If winners are mixed but improve only through one fragile priority/cost setting,or allocated capacity/host handling erases the margin,do not promote it as a general existing-hardware placement contribution.
limitations: No new inference,large experiment,solver run,subagent or edits to sealed artifacts. This file is an additive follow-up;prior completion manifest remains unchanged.
